role: Descriptive cross-dataset comparison after the already prospectively frozen AusTraits inference. This comparison cannot alter either dataset's within-source decisions.
required_comparisons: family conditional repeatability: BIEN versus AusTraits S3, with prune descriptive sensitivity
held-out-family rank portability gain and one-sided p on S3 and prune
well-represented trait-pair weighted reversal probability on S3 and prune
matched raw-versus-log rank portability and reversal direction
trait-set overlap/anchor count and provenance label

validation_language.architecture_validated: AusTraits shows positive significant rank portability on both tree axes and at least substantial pair-order reordering (>=1/3) on both axes under the pre-frozen decision rules.
validation_language.strong_architecture_validated: Same as architecture_validated with reversal >=0.40 on both axes.
validation_language.partial_or_axis_sensitive: Only one tree axis or one scale supports the conjunction.
validation_language.not_validated: The pre-frozen global-spectrum portability component is absent on S3 or reordering is below 1/3 on either tree axis.

hard_nonclaims: Do not require numerical equality of BIEN and AusTraits effect sizes.
Do not relabel AusTraits as independent-source replication.
Do not privilege raw or log scale based on which matches BIEN better.
Do not extend conclusions to Blomberg K or Pagel lambda.
